title: Genomic landscape of meningiomas: genotyping
sex_distribution: 53 female, 32 male (n=85, corrected 2026-07-10: matches Series_overall_design's '53 female and 32 male subjects' exactly; the earlier n=170 figure double-counted every patient because each of the 85 patients was genotyped on 2 SNP array platforms -- GPL2004 'Hind' and GPL2005 'Xba', confirmed by direct GSM inspection, e.g. GSM815639/Meningioma_1024_Hind_50k and the corresponding Xba-platform GSM for the same patient ID both carry identical demographics)
age_distribution: n=85, range 31.0-89.0, mean 62.1 (corrected 2026-07-10 from n=170 for the same double-counting reason as sex_distribution; range/mean unchanged since each patient's age value is identical across its 2 GSM chip records)
needs_manual_review_reason: PER-SAMPLE DATA UPDATE (2026-07-10, corrected same day during fact-check pass): Rich per-sample clinical data recovered directly from the series' family.soft file: WHO grade, sex, age, vital status, and a recurrence-frequency count per sample. CORRECTION: an earlier extraction pass tallied these fields across all 170 GSM records and reported grade_breakdown 114/40/16, sex 106F/64M, and vital status 146 Alive/24 Deceased -- this double-counted every patient, because the series contains 170 GSM records for only 85 unique patients (each patient was genotyped on 2 SNP array platforms, GPL2004 'Hind' and GPL2005 'Xba', producing 2 GSM entries per patient with identical characteristics). Confirmed directly: Sample_title values pair up 1:1 by patient ID across the two platforms (e.g. patient 984 appears as both a Hind and an Xba GSM with matching grade/sex/age), and every per-sample tally exactly halves to match the study's own stated cohort description (Series_overall_design: '53 female and 32 male subjects... 57 tumors WHO I, 20 WHO II, 8 WHO III' = 85 total). All affected fields (patient_count, sample_count, grade_breakdown, sex_distribution, age_distribution) have been corrected to the true n=85 patient-level counts. RECURRENCE DATA (corrected, n=85): recurrence_frequency 72 patients with 0 recurrences, 4 with 1, 5 with 2, 1 with 4, 2 with 5, 1 with 9 (halved from the raw 170-GSM tally of 144/8/10/2/4/2); a 'tts' (time-to-something, likely time-to-survival-event) field with values not yet parsed for exact meaning remains unextracted. OUTCOME DATA (corrected, n=85): vital status 73 Alive, 12 Deceased (halved from 146/24 across 170 GSM records). Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; remaining per-sample fields (anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) not yet extracted from individual GSM records. PUBLICATION STATUS CORRECTION (2026-07-10 re-verification pass): publication_status was 'normal' but PubMed's record for PMID 20015288 lists an 'Erratum in' reference (Brain Pathol. 2011 Jul;21(4):478); confirmed via Crossref (DOI 10.1111/j.1750-3639.2011.00503.x, references the original article's DOI) and the corrigendum's PMC full text (PMC8094315, no PMID assigned): the correction is limited to mislabeled supporting-information table/figure numbers, it does not affect the deposited data or reported results. publication_status updated to 'corrected' and the corrigendum added as a second publications entry. COMPLETENESS FIX (2026-07-13, corpus-wide tag audit): treatment_timepoint_status had been left at 'Not reported' even though tags.recurrence_annotated is true and this record's own notes above already document genuine per-sample primary/recurrent data. Corrected to ['primary', 'recurrent'] to match. CORRECTION (2026-07-14, live-source deep audit): the 2026-07-13 fix above was itself wrong -- it conflated the per-sample 'recurrence_frequency' field (a lifetime OUTCOME count of how many times that patient's tumor later recurred during follow-up, already correctly supporting has_outcome_data=true) with a genuine per-SAMPLE primary-vs-recurrent specimen classification. Fetched and read the paper's own text directly (Lee et al. 2010, Brain Pathology, PMID 20015288, PMC3167483): it states verbatim 'Tumor biopsies from 53 female and 32 male subjects with sporadic meningioma were identified from the UCLA Neuro-oncology Program Tissue Bank' and, critically, 'Only eight primary samples analyzed in this data set were sampled from patients who had a later recurrence. None of the recurrent biopsies were available for analysis.' This confirms all 85 deposited samples are PRIMARY (initial-surgery) specimens; 'recurrent' in this study is exclusively a downstream clinical-outcome label describing what later happened to the patient, not a description of any deposited tissue itself -- the authors explicitly did not have access to any actual recurrent-tumor biopsies. Re-verified live via GSE16583_family.soft: the only per-sample fields are age, gender, recurrence_frequency (a count, values 0/1/2/4/5/9, not a primary/recurrent label), tissue (uniformly 'meningioma tumor' for all 170 GSM records, no primary/recurrent distinction), tts, vital status, and who grade -- there is no field anywhere that labels any individual sample as a recurrent-tumor specimen. treatment_timepoint_status corrected back to ['primary'] only (removing the incorrect 'recurrent' value), and tags.recurrence_annotated corrected from true back to false, since this dataset does not in fact distinguish primary-vs-recurrent SAMPLES (the schema's own bar for that tag) -- it distinguishes primary samples by their patients' later recurrence outcome, which is a has_outcome_data fact, not a recurrence_annotated fact. has_outcome_data remains correctly true (vital status + recurrence-outcome counts are genuine survival/outcome data) and grade_breakdown/sex/age/vital-status counts were independently re-verified against the live family.soft during this same pass and remain unchanged and accurate (85 unique patients via Hind/Xba platform-pair dedup, grade 57/20/8, 73 Alive/12 Deceased, recurrence_frequency 72/4/5/0/1/2/0/0/0/1/0/0(=values 0:72,1:4,2:5,4:1,5:2,9:1)). CORRESPONDING-AUTHOR CORRECTION (2026-08-04): field previously read 'Yohan Lee, Stanley F Nelson' -- Lee (first author) is not the designated corresponding author. Re-verified against the paper's own PMC full text (PMID 20015288, PMCID PMC3167483): the author-notes/corresp block names only 'Stanley F. Nelson, MD ... snelson@ucla.edu', and the contrib-group flags corresp="yes" on Stanley Nelson alone. Corrected to Nelson only.
